scripts.coverage: npm run build && find build/src -name '*.test.js' -exec node --test --experimental-test-coverage {} \;
scripts.test: npm run build && find build/src -name '*.test.js' -exec node --test {} \;
scripts.testw: npm run build && find build/src -name '*.test.js' -exec node --test --watch {} \;
scripts.clear-cache: npx rimraf cache/* !cache/README.md && npx rimraf cache.json && echo "Cache cleared successfully!"
